I replied in the #inc-vtg-hartford thread under your message.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836, and you posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07. The channel doesn't say more about the guard's activity than the clipboard and that check-in, so for more detail, ask the guard or check the site log.
